# wso2is_validation_rules (Resource)

Sets the validation rules for usernames or passwords. In the Console, these rules are under **Login & Registration > Password Validation** and **Username Validation**. Use either rule validators or a single regular expression. When you destroy the resource, the provider sets the field's rules back to the server defaults, unless `restore_on_destroy = false`. To import, use the field name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_validation_rules" "password" {
  field = "password"
  rules = [
    { validator = "LengthValidator", properties = { "min.length" = "12", "max.length" = "64" } },
    { validator = "NumeralValidator", properties = { "min.length" = "1" } },
    { validator = "UpperCaseValidator", properties = { "min.length" = "1" } },
    { validator = "LowerCaseValidator", properties = { "min.length" = "1" } },
    { validator = "SpecialCharacterValidator", properties = { "min.length" = "1" } },
    { validator = "RepeatedCharacterValidator", properties = { "max.consecutive.character" = "3" } },
  ]
}

# Usernames: rule validators only (the server rejects a regular expression here).
resource "wso2is_validation_rules" "username" {
  field = "username"
  rules = [
    { validator = "LengthValidator", properties = { "min.length" = "3", "max.length" = "40" } },
    { validator = "AlphanumericValidator", properties = { "enable.validator" = "true", "enable.special.characters" = "true" } },
  ]
}

# Alternatively, one regular expression for passwords:
# resource "wso2is_validation_rules" "password" {
#   field = "password"
#   regex = "^(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*[0-9]).{12,64}$"
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `field` (String) `password` or `username`.

### Optional

- `regex` (String) A JavaScript regular expression that the value must match (the server's `JsRegExValidator`). You cannot use it together with `rules`. Only passwords accept a regular expression. The server rejects one for `username`.
- `restore_on_destroy` (Boolean) Revert the field's rules to the server defaults on destroy. The default is `true`.
- `rules` (Attributes Set) Rule validators, for example `LengthValidator` (`min.length`, `max.length`), `NumeralValidator`, `UpperCaseValidator`, `LowerCaseValidator`, `SpecialCharacterValidator` (`min.length`), `UniqueCharacterValidator` (`min.unique.character`), `RepeatedCharacterValidator` (`max.consecutive.character`), `AlphanumericValidator` (`enable.validator`, `enable.special.characters`), `EmailFormatValidator` (`enable.validator`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `field`.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `properties` (Map of String) Validator properties.
- `validator` (String) Validator name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_validation_rules.password password
```
